billing.covers: charges, invoices, refunds, plan changes, payment failures, tax/VAT

account_access.covers: login, password reset, 2FA, SSO for a single user, seat invites

bug.covers: something that used to work or should work is broken for this customer; errors, crashes, wrong data

how_to.covers: usage questions, configuration help, best practices

feature_request.covers: asking for something the product does not do

integration.covers: Slack, Salesforce, Zapier, API, webhooks, SSO/SAML configuration

cancellation.covers: wants to cancel, downgrade, or expresses intent to leave

sales.covers: Enterprise pricing, quotes, procurement, security questionnaires for prospects

outage.signals: multiple users or whole workspace affected, service unreachable, widespread 5xx, data not loading for everyone, status-page-type language

security.signals: suspected breach, unauthorized access, leaked credentials, vulnerability report, phishing impersonating us

legal.signals: lawyer/attorney, legal action, subpoena, GDPR/CCPA data-subject request, DPA, regulator, chargeback dispute threats citing law
